messages:
alicia: Quick dry-run notes from tonight's evening shoulder-window sim. Ran loadgen against eu-west/us-east mix to mimic the summer promo. Short thread with results and proposed mitigations.

sam: thanks — TL;DR numbers?

alicia: Peak simulated tokens/sec overall ~1.05M t/s. Per-GPU sustained tokens/sec on rdx-13b-q4 was ~980–1,050 t/s depending on seq len. Concurrent requests peaked ~3.2k. p99 latency up ~12% in eu-west when seq > 512.

ryan: how does that compare to our headroom target (20%)?

alicia: headroom dropped to ~8% in eu-west core racks at peak. us-east kept ~22% because we had spare prewarm pool there. We saw two node evictions that correlated with a short network jitter window.

infra-bot: alert: live-eviction eu-west-1 rack07 at 2026-06-15T19:12Z — evicted 2 GPUs (reason: kernel OOM -> evict). Incident ref /inc/1234.

maria: cost question — if we shift more traffic to us-east as fallback, what's the daily egress + cross-region sync hit?

alicia: rough ballpark: cross-region fallback adds ~\$2.4k/day at projected rates (model sync + egress). Prewarm extra GPUs are cheaper per-day.

jayden: quick mitigation ideas: (1) bump eu-west prewarm pool 12 -> 20 during 18:00–22:00 (2) cap seq len for casual traffic at 768 via routing (3) allow on-demand scale with 10m warmup for dedicated pools.

sam: can we simulate that config quickly?

alicia: I ran a focused sim with prewarm=20 and seq cap. Command used: ```./simulate_traffic --rps 12000 --seq-avg 640 --duration 45m --model rdx-13b-q4 --prewarm 20``` snippet output: ```p99: 220ms -> 180ms; headroom eu-west: 18% -> 24%; concurrent peak: 2.6k -> 2.9k (with less tail spikes)```

ryan: any remaining network anomalies after the change?

alicia: sustained packetQ bursts on the 10G uplink at rack07 still show jitter under load. Ops scheduled NIC firmware push overnight which should reduce micro-evictions.

maria: :chart_with_upwards_trend: quick cost calc: extra prewarm GPUs ~\$1.1k/day. If we enable cross-region fallback for 10% traffic the incremental is ~\$600/day in egress (on top of model sync ~\$1.8k/day) — totals line up with my earlier ~\$2.4k/day. Tradeoff vs SLA: seems reasonable for promo nights.

jayden: recommended plan: enable prewarm bump + routing seq cap + canary fallback to us-east for 10% traffic. Watch the token/sec knee metric and abort if headroom < 15% for 5m.

deploy-bot: canary: routing rule 'evening-shoulder-fallback' started at 2026-06-15T20:05Z -> routing 10% eu-west traffic -> us-east.

sam: action items: alicia -> update autoscale & prewarm schedule, jayden -> apply routing AB and sequence cap, ryan -> schedule NIC firmware push, maria -> finalize cost approval. I'll follow up tomorrow 10:30 PT.

alicia: adding run artifacts and logs to the infra board: https://redwood-internal/boards/INFRA/shoulder-dryrun  (contains sim logs, raw token/sec traces, and the small code snippet used).

sam: thanks — nice quick iteration. :thumbsup:
